title: FastVibe — Your desktop, ready for agent work
description: An open-source desktop workspace built on pi-coding-agent. Choose your models, extend your tools, and inspect the source from interface to agent engine.

hero.lead: From coding to everyday work, FastVibe connects to your local files, terminal, and tools to help you execute, organize, verify, and turn ideas into deliverable results.
hero.title:
A workspace for your agents,
built for real work.

workspace.title: Work with the full context
workspace.copy: Keep your conversation beside the files you're working on. Let your agent explore the project, make a plan and carry it through — while code previews and progress stay within reach.
workspace.alt: FastVibe in English: a Fieldnotes quick-search task, completed checklist and TypeScript file preview

review.title: See what changed, and why
review.copy: Tool calls and file changes are part of the conversation, not a separate trail to track down. Open a diff, review each edit and work with Git without leaving your task.
review.alt: FastVibe in English: reviewing the CommandMenu keyboard-navigation diff in the Git pane

models.title: Make the workspace your own
models.copy: Use the models you trust and the tools you already know. Configure providers, connect MCP servers and install skills and extensions. Your workflow doesn't have to fit a single provider.
models.alt: FastVibe in English: model and provider configuration

download.fallback: Get the latest release on GitHub

practices.heading: The best ways to use FastVibe

plugins.title: Plugins & MCP
plugins.description: Connect the tools and professional services you use every day so FastVibe can gather information, use their capabilities, and deliver results in one workflow.

agents.title: Parallel subagents
agents.description: Hand independent subtasks to explorer, planner, worker, and reviewer roles and run them in parallel. Each subagent has its own conversation you can read or stop at any time.

remote.title: Remote control
remote.description: Check progress and add instructions from your phone so tasks keep moving while you are away from your computer. Tunneling and device authorization are built in.

browser.title: Built-in browser
browser.description: Let the agent browse the web, organize information, and verify results, connecting research, action, and delivery in one complete loop.

desktop.title: Desktop
desktop.copy: Connect local files, tools, and your terminal to complete full tasks and deliver usable results from your computer.

mobile.title: Mobile
mobile.copy: Check progress, add instructions, and remotely continue your desktop workflow wherever you are.

login.title: Sign in to FastVibe
login.lead: Continue with your GitHub account. We read your public profile and your verified email — never your password.
